school.name: Maspeth High School
school.overview: Maspeth High School was founded in September 2011. We operate under the classical philosophy that all knowledge is interrelated. We expect all of our students to graduate with an Arts Endorsed, Advanced Regents diploma in four years and attend top four-year colleges and universities. A graduate of Maspeth High School will be fully prepared for college, career, and productive citizenship.

programs.name: Maspeth High School (Q47A)
programs.description: Students will have taken four years of Classical Language, Latin or Mandarin, and be fully prepared for college, career, and productive citizenship. Students are strongly encouraged to take on AP and College Level Courses in order to challenge themselves throughout their four years of high school.
